rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Never use standard sans for headings. Use Barlow Condensed for a heavy-weight athletic feel.
Add Barlow Condensed and Inter via Google Fonts.
True Grey Base: Avoid pure #000000 black. Use dark grey surfaces (#09090B to #18181B).
Layered Elevation: Use background lightness to communicate hierarchy, not shadows. Step surface colors 3-6% lighter for each nested level.
Semantic Color Tuning: Desaturate success, warning, and error colors for dark surfaces.
Primary Accent: Neon Volt Green (#C4F601) for primary actions, progress bars, and kinetic triggers to evoke elite athleticism.

surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Container with border-collapse style layout, items with subtle borders (border-white/10).
Neumorphism (Tactile): Mix 1px sharp inner contrasts (border-white/5) instead of soft shadows to ensure accessibility on dark mode.
Solid Backgrounds: Use flat solid surfaces instead of glass to prevent visual refraction of data.
effects: Tactical Minimalism: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.
No full-screen gradients. Use texture (grain/noise) over gloss.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Always use solid dark colors (e.g., bg-zinc-950).

components.strategy: Shadcn UI + Customization for Tactical Minimalism
rules: Go cardless or use rectangular, dense styles. Max 4px to 8px border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md).
Buttons: Sharp edges, solid background with high-contrast text. Example: bg-[#C4F601] text-black font-bold.
Forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox. Flat backgrounds with 1px border. Never use native inputs.
Charts: Use Shadcn chart components or Recharts with dark-first palettes. Desaturated gridlines.
Use sonner for toast notifications.

spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use p-6 or p-8 for internal container padding to prevent text collision.
Bento Grid Protocol (High Density): Base grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
Summary widgets: col-span-1. Primary data/video: col-span-2 or col-span-3.
rules: Mobile-First: Always start with grid-cols-1.
Sidebar Navigation: Fixed on desktop, hidden behind a hamburger menu on mobile.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Minimalist animations: use micro-interactions for feedback.
Hover states on all interactive elements (must explicitly set text color on hover, e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
Focus states: HIGHER contrast than default state (e.g., focus:ring-[#C4F601]).
MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Normal Text: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Large Text: Minimum 3:1 contrast ratio.
NEVER rely on inheritance for hover text colors.
Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations/icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-video-button').
Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile.
Overlay Opacity: max bg-black/50 for hero/video overlays.
Video Thumbnails: Use high-quality fitness action shots with play button overlays.
Not required for this dense dashboard. Prioritize Recharts for performance and clarity.
Use lucide-react for iconography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern SaaS dashboard for 'Panou Antrenor' (ELVISPROCUT.RO) in Romanian language.
The app uses standard .js / .jsx files (NOT .tsx). Do not write TypeScript syntax.
Apply the 'Performance Pro' dark theme with Deep Obsidian backgrounds (#09090B) and Neon Volt Green (#C4F601) accents.

Pages to build: Auth (Login/Register via email & Google), Dashboard Overview (stats: reels created, quota, recent projects), Video Project Management (upload progress, AI edit plan review: transcript, hook, caption, CTA, hashtags, suggested cuts, music), and Subscription/Billing (Stripe tiers: Coach, Coach+, Gym/Studio).
Use Shadcn components, customized for 'Tactical Minimalism' (flat, 1px borders, minimal radii, intense neon accents for CTAs).
Incorporate data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements.
Avoid using complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, sidebars, or sticky headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use the defined typography (Barlow Condensed for headers, Inter for body) and tight layout rules.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and background lightness (no heavy drop shadows).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always explicitly set text colors on hover/focus states.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons; use lucide-react.
Implement micro-animations for hover, focus, and loading states.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Design with intent: every screen must have a clear primary action (e.g., 'Încarcă video' or 'Aprobă Reel').
Visual Hierarchy: Use Barlow Condensed for high-impact metric numbers and headers, keeping Inter for dense table data.
Frictionless Forms: Reviewing the AI plan should feel like a simple checklist, with clear 'Aprobă' or 'Regenerează' actions.
Consistent Alignment: Left-align forms, tables, and dense data. Center-align only empty states or specific modal actions.
